resources.string: Welcome to SawEars.\nClick the info button for instructions, or click 'start lesson' to get started!
Set the lowest note your instrument can produce, as a midi value. This allows the application to transpose songs to fit your playable range.
Set the highest note your instrument can produce, as a midi value. This allows the application to transpose songs to fit your playable range.

Controls how sensitive the app is to changes in pitch (1=easiest, 5=hardest). At higher difficulties you will need to meet the target pitch very precisely. At lower difficulties a wider range of pitches will be accepted.

Control the default lesson mode\nPractice: The lesson will wait for you to produce the correct note before proceeding, allowing you to practice the song at your own pace.\nPerformance: The lesson will continue at the tempo you set, like a karaoke performance.
Controls margin to display around melody, e.g. if set to 5 the highest note displayed will be 5 midi notes higher than the highest note in the melody.
Warning: Range too small for current song. This song may not be playable for your instrument.
Range min must be less than or equal to range max
Pitch display margin cannot be negative
